objective: Ship This as a Finished Product.

domain_meanings.meaning: Stable human/installation/Companion/session IDs describe an actor; an authenticated principal requires actual accepted identity evidence and lifetime binding.
domain_meanings.current_limit: Strict record shape and identifier predicates do not authenticate a principal.

domain_meanings.meaning: Role names identify duties. Technical independence depends on actual boundaries and administrative control.
domain_meanings.current_limit: One executor and local native reference do not create an independent reviewer or external authority.

domain_meanings.meaning: An exact logical application/project boundary with ordered history and authorized resources. A path/name alone does not grant cross-scope access; an authorized bridge names both scopes.
domain_meanings.current_limit: Relevant-state and error resource bindings are pure checks; resource handles and OS access are not implemented.

domain_meanings.meaning: Current authoritative state derives from accepted ordered events and verified projections. Retained historical records keep their original identity/evidence scope.
domain_meanings.current_limit: Event commitments and genesis/link checks do not provide persistence, signatures, tail protection or crash recovery.

domain_meanings.term: Consent, standing grant and one-operation permit
domain_meanings.meaning: Consent preserves authentic bounded human choice; standing grants allow bounded preparation/classes under conditions; a permit admits one exact consequential operation at the current linearization boundary.
domain_meanings.current_limit: No consent acquisition, permission service, atomic reservation or permit consumption exists in the rebuild.

domain_meanings.term: Prepared proposal and current relevant state
domain_meanings.meaning: Prepared candidates preserve exact intent, resources, dependencies and current relevant revisions. A current candidate is still a proposal requiring authority.
domain_meanings.current_limit: Read-set equality and stale-state predicates do not lock resources or make consumption atomic.

domain_meanings.meaning: Admission/dispatch is an attempted operation; a receipt is process evidence; independent observation evaluates the actual postcondition; the kernel settles with sufficient current evidence.
domain_meanings.current_limit: Error uncertainty predicates preserve reconciliation; no actual execution or observation was performed.

domain_meanings.meaning: Registered guidance and recovery state explain a bounded failure. They never authorize automatic retry, budget refund, diagnostic disclosure or success.
domain_meanings.current_limit: Run10 covers pure registered-envelope bindings; actual recovery, redaction and access control remain untested.

domain_meanings.meaning: A capability claim binds exact installed source/binary/model/template/hardware/policy/configuration and required evidence within a declared profile.
domain_meanings.current_limit: Asset presence, endpoint liveness, historical passes and serializer agreement do not qualify current inference or the product.

domain_meanings.meaning: Migration preserves legacy records, originals and uncertainty; historical grants/readiness never silently become current authority.
domain_meanings.current_limit: Worktree checkpoints preserve source; no live-data migration or restore rehearsal has occurred.

domain_meanings.meaning: Each agreed obligation needs its specified actual implementation and evidence or an explicit owner scope change; profile activation and full mission completion stay distinct.
domain_meanings.current_limit: Thirty source applicability assessments and 94 prior unit passes do not close Gate A or any full acceptance case.

transition_runtime: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; supplied TR01-TR20 are required predicates, not enforcement

feasibility_and_control_obligations.label: Persistent ordered history and current authority
feasibility_and_control_obligations.required_predicate: One protected canonical writer; atomic intent/reservation; current authenticated epochs; crash-safe ordered append/recovery and verified backup.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.current_evidence_and_limit: Run10 covers pure events/time/relevant-state inputs. No store, real clock provider, authenticated signing, anchor or transaction exists.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.next_executable_probe: After Gate A, implement store/kernel fixtures and run actual concurrent writer, full-disk, reboot, tamper/tail, backup and recovery probes.

feasibility_and_control_obligations.label: Authenticated Windows peers and bounded effects
feasibility_and_control_obligations.required_predicate: Actual peer, generation, handle, permit, fence and OS controls bind the effect; every entry path preserves deny and stop.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.current_evidence_and_limit: Strict shapes/current-state/error predicates are source-tested only. Native serializer is test infrastructure, not containment or authenticated broker.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.next_executable_probe: Implement exact supported local transport and restricted-principal broker; probe forged peers, stale generation, egress, aliases, races, inherited credentials and unsupported boundaries.

feasibility_and_control_obligations.label: Crash gaps, independent readback and reconciliation
feasibility_and_control_obligations.required_predicate: A possible/spent effect cannot be replayed/refunded from acknowledgment or exit zero; actual independent evidence settles or preserves uncertainty.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.current_evidence_and_limit: Run10 validates pure uncertainty/recovery semantics; it contains no real dispatch, independent observation, budget accounting or recovery.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.next_executable_probe: Execute bounded success/deny/stale/crash-after-effect/receipt-without-effect/restart/readback variants under the real broker and store.

feasibility_and_control_obligations.label: Scoped data and cognition across projects
feasibility_and_control_obligations.required_predicate: Access is admitted before read/capture; exact requests and uncertainty survive; cross-scope data, reflection and sensitive diagnostics remain governed.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.current_evidence_and_limit: Normal-profile contents untouched; pure scope checks do not implement authorized observation, private memory, capture, forgetting or diagnostic disclosure.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.next_executable_probe: Implement authorized fixture observation/context/memory and run cross-project canaries, correction/forgetting, reflection promotion and scope-correct diagnostics through ordinary entry paths.

feasibility_and_control_obligations.label: Owned inference, exact quality and bounded resources
feasibility_and_control_obligations.required_predicate: CETA-owned exact pinned GGUF/backend/tokenizer/template and ordinary request path meet quality/stop/resource thresholds on the declared actual machine.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.current_evidence_and_limit: Historical 0.6B strict quality/format failures and unqualified 4B inference remain confirmed baseline issues. No rebuild inference, latency, resource or installed quality run occurred.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.next_executable_probe: After compiler prerequisites, pin/import authorized assets and backend, exercise actual normal inference/cancel/drift/held-out quality, then measure complete path under growth and pressure.

feasibility_and_control_obligations.label: Object custody and actual distributed authority
feasibility_and_control_obligations.required_predicate: Object-scoped release uses qualified consumer controls and independently administered domain contributions; repeated authorized decryption, replay, cleanup and recovery work.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.current_evidence_and_limit: No custody, real quorum, key lifecycle, independent administrative domain, hardware or residual-secret proof implemented. Their availability is not assumed and not yet an observed blocker.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.next_executable_probe: Implement recorded object/key protocols and consumer boundaries; run decryption/replay/recovery and missing/mixed quorum probes, then obtain actual independent-domain/hardware evidence at its gate.

feasibility_and_control_obligations.label: Human agency, native accessibility and migration conservation
feasibility_and_control_obligations.required_predicate: The real native workflow preserves drafts, exact consent, denial, stop and recovery; category-specific migration preserves originals/uncertainty with one authorized active writer.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.current_evidence_and_limit: Direct owner instructions are stated needs; no observed usability or accessibility research. Source checkpoints are verified; no live-data migration or installed journey.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.next_executable_probe: Implement normal and exception native paths, synthetic legacy-schema migration fixtures and rehearsals; run full journeys/accessibility checks, then collect authorized actual user/installed evidence.

feasibility_and_control_obligations.label: Candidate identity, installed operation and real elapsed endurance
feasibility_and_control_obligations.required_predicate: Independent verification binds exact candidate and dependency bytes; clean offline installation, whole journey, performance and seven real elapsed days pass before separate cutover/release decisions.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.current_evidence_and_limit: Original manifest/source integrity and historical source tests are bounded evidence only. No candidate, clean install, independent verifier, elapsed campaign, cutover or publication exists.
feasibility_and_control_obligations.next_executable_probe: Build exact pinned candidate after dependencies, verify and install in a clean target; run offline/growth/endurance/independent evidence and present the reviewable release/cutover decision.

causal_risks.cause: Shared store/epoch/clock or stale relevant-state assumptions fail together
causal_risks.possible_event: An expired/revoked operation is admitted or recovery replays a spent attempt
causal_risks.consequence: Unauthorized or duplicate effects and false history
causal_risks.obligation_label: Persistent ordered history and current authority

causal_risks.cause: Logical role, claimed peer or path is treated as an actual security boundary
causal_risks.possible_event: A compromised worker bypasses the broker or substitutes resources
causal_risks.consequence: Unauthorized reads, writes, egress or key access
causal_risks.obligation_label: Authenticated Windows peers and bounded effects

causal_risks.cause: Receipt loss, timeout or process exit is promoted to settlement
causal_risks.possible_event: Uncertain external work is retried/refunded or reported completed
causal_risks.consequence: Duplicate effects, lost budget and untruthful task state
causal_risks.obligation_label: Crash gaps, independent readback and reconciliation

causal_risks.cause: Source/context/memory/diagnostics/capture paths share unchecked scope or retention
causal_risks.possible_event: Another project or private content enters a request/output or survives forgetting
causal_risks.consequence: Disclosure, contaminated decisions and user-agency loss
causal_risks.obligation_label: Scoped data and cognition across projects

causal_risks.cause: Backend/model/template or resource configuration changes without requalification
causal_risks.possible_event: Ordinary requests fail semantics, stop or resource thresholds
causal_risks.consequence: Unreliable outcomes, unusable native workflow and unbounded resource pressure
causal_risks.obligation_label: Owned inference, exact quality and bounded resources

causal_risks.cause: One administrator/device is relabelled independent or key lifetime is unqualified
causal_risks.possible_event: False quorum/replay or residual secrets permit unintended release
causal_risks.consequence: Custody failure and unjustified cryptographic assurance
causal_risks.obligation_label: Object custody and actual distributed authority

causal_risks.cause: Legacy schema/unknown data or human exception paths are insufficiently checked
causal_risks.possible_event: Migration loses meaning/data, grants stale authority, or UI obscures stop/denial
causal_risks.consequence: Irrecoverable user loss or effects beyond understood consent
causal_risks.obligation_label: Human agency, native accessibility and migration conservation

causal_risks.cause: Shared source/toolchain/tests or historical success is mistaken for independent current qualification
causal_risks.possible_event: Wrong candidate is activated or untested property is reported green
causal_risks.consequence: False readiness with unqualified installed behavior
causal_risks.obligation_label: Candidate identity, installed operation and real elapsed endurance

risk_issue_unknown_blocker_distinction: Causal entries describe possible events. Confirmed failures retain actual issue evidence. Unmeasured feasibility is unknown; no external blocker is established.
current_vs_projected_controls: Only named bounded existing evidence is current; next probes and specified runtime controls are future treatments, not effective controls.
review_triggers: Expired evidence or changed trust domain
